sentences.text: Rule twenty-three covers power-driven vessels underway.
She shows a masthead light forward, sidelights and a sternlight.
A vessel fifty meters or more must also show a second masthead light abaft of and higher than the forward one.
A vessel under fifty meters may show the second masthead light but isn’t required to.
The two masthead lights act like a range, telling you which way a big ship is heading and when she starts to turn.
A power-driven vessel under twelve meters may instead show an all-round white light and sidelights, which is what most center consoles carry.
